definitions.short: properly, to draw together the feet (as an animal about to dart upon its prey), i.e. to spring forward
definitions.full: H2187. zanaq [ זָנַק ] verb only Pi`el leap (Late Hebrew זִנֵּק cause to spring, spurt ; Aramaic throw, shoot , also bind ) — Imperfect 3masculine singular מִןהַֿבָּשָׁן יְזַנֵּק Deut 33:22 he leapeth forth from Bashan (of Dan under figure of lion's whelp). זֵעָה see יָזַע . זְעָוָה see זְוָעָה below זוּעַ .
